correct_completion: she handed it to her manager.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, she handed it to her manager.
acceptable_variants: she then gave it to her manager.
she sent it to her manager by email.

options.text: the manager was sitting in the office.
options.why_wrong: The participle clause needs the same subject as the main clause. Here the manager is not the one who finished the report, so the sentence contains a dangling participle.
'So' introduces a result, and the sentence does not need a result here. The main clause should describe the next action of the person who finished the report.

options.text: she handed it to her manager.

options.why_wrong: This describes a separate event. The subject of the main clause must be the person who finished the report.

explanation: A 'having + past participle' clause shows an action completed before the main action. The main clause must have the same subject as the participle clause.
